Hi @FirstName@,
Thank you for requesting a Soundtrack Your Brand free trial.
Unfortunately, we couldn't approve your request because some of the information submitted couldn't be verified.
Before submitting another request, please confirm:
The request is for a legitimate business.
The business information is accurate.
The business hasn't previously received a free trial.
Once updated, you're welcome to submit another request.
Need assistance? We’re here to help.
Call us Monday–Friday, 9 AM–6 PM ET at 586-978-4214. You can also reach us by email at CustomerService@dm-us.com.
Thank you!
The Dynamic Media Team
